datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Malawi to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets for multiple projection scenarios (January, April, July, October 2012), enabling temporal and spatial analysis of food insecurity risk.
